name: Special Joint City Council & Planning Commission Meeting (AB 2011/SB 6/AB 2243) 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council & Planning Commission Meeting (AB 2011/SB 6/AB 2243) 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 29, 2025 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER / ROLL CALL
City Council: Mayor Ehlers, Deputy Mayor Lyndes, Council Members O'Hara, San Antonio, and Shaffer
Planning Commission: Chair Dalton, Vice Chair Ryan, Commissioners Prendergast, Sherod, and Whitteker
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Joint community workshop with the City Council and Planning Commission to review and receive feedback on (1) the draft implementing ordinance for AB 2011/SB 6 and AB 2243 and (2) amendments to the Downtown Encinitas and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to add objective design standards for housing development projects. Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because they are not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The actions involve organizational or administrative activities of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Persons: Senior Planner Cadona and Planning Manager Anders
Receive the report and provide feedback regarding the draft implementing ordinance and draft objective design standards for the Downtown Encinitas and North 101 Corridor Specific Plan presented in this report.
2025-10-29 Item 01 - AB 2011 SB 6 Special Joint Meeting City Council and Planning Commission
2025-10-29 Item 01 - AB 2011 SB 6 Special Joint Meeting City Council and Planning Commission - Public Comment
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
